preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 100000 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The length of each string S in test_cases is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
Each string S in test_cases contains only lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each result in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= len(S) + 1 for result, S in zip(output, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and the length of the corresponding string S plus one inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == sum(1 for i in range(len(S) + 1) if S[:i] == S[i-1::-1]) for result, S in zip(output, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is the number of positions in the string S where a character can be inserted to form a palindrome.
